entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3 24-01-2013 Heard learned counsels for the petitioner and the State.
The petitioner is apprehending arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 51 and 59 of the Food and Safety Standard Act.
It is alleged that the wheat in the go-down of the petitioner who was the Assistant Go-down Manager of the Food Corporation, unit Khagaria were found to be sub-standard.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the grains were supplied by the FSS and for standard quality, the petitioner cannot be held responsible when the search seizure were not made as per the FCC regulations.

Considering the aforesaid facts, let the above named petitioner be released on anticipatory bail, in the event of arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of 12 weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khagaria in connection with Khagaria (Chitragupta Nagar) P.S. Case No. 154 of 2012, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
(Dinesh Kumar Singh, J) Amrendra/-
